## Aim 1 Trial-Level Readiness

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
subject = params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(params["export_dir"])
trials = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_trials.csv")
trials.head()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(readr)
subject <- params$subject
export_dir <- params$export_dir
trials <- read_csv(file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_trials.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
trials$condition <- factor(trials$condition)
fit <- lmer(prestim_beta ~ condition + pos_in_block + (1|block_id), data = trials)
print(summary(fit))
ggplot(trials, aes(x=condition, y=prestim_beta, fill=condition)) + geom_violin(trim=FALSE, alpha=.4) + geom_boxplot(width=.15, outlier.shape = NA)
```
